name: Shark Tank India
description: Aspiring entrepreneurs from India pitch their business models to a panel of investors and persuade them to invest money in their idea.

videos.title: Badlegi Business Ki Tasveer
videos.overview: BluePine Foods, led by Aditi Madan, Booz Scooters led by Rutvij Dasadia and Heart Up My Sleeves led by Riya Khattar, pitch their ideas to the sharks to invest in their businesses. Who will the sharks choose, and what will their offer price be?

videos.title: Insaan, Ideas Aur Sapne
videos.overview: Urban Gen Z healthy snack brand, 'Tagz', a scientific magic, mid brain optimisation brand, 'Head and Heart' or a brand that empowers farmers through tourism, 'Agri Tourism', which pitch will impress the sharks?

videos.title: Aam Aadmi Ke Business Ideas

videos.title: Unique Ventures And Big Ambitions
videos.overview: Eco-friendly aroma products by Nytarra, affordable archery equipment by BLYX, and a marketplace for data-specific currency notes by GreenPista enter the tank. With fresh innovations on display, will the founders secure the funding they seek?

videos.title: Vision Meets Venture
videos.overview: An AI-powered 3D platform and editor by Ctruh, home steam and sauna solutions by SteamPRO, and co-living and accommodation by Uptown enter the tank. As the founders make their pitches, will they secure the funding they are looking for?

videos.title: Smart Solutions For Modern Living
videos.overview: Korean beauty solutions by KorinMi, full fledged dental treatment at your doorstep by Dent@Home, and marble home decor and gifting by Marbleous enter the tank. As the founders aim to make everyday living easier with their brands, will the Sharks believe in their vision?

videos.title: Fitness, Fertility And Farming Innovation
videos.overview: Activewear for women by Fitkin, at-home fertility testing kits by Kind Fertility, and a cow dung and urine collection device by NAMO Vardan enter the tank. How will the Sharks respond to the founder's pitches?

videos.title: Pitches For The Planet
videos.overview: Innovative sustainable construction by Circato, sustainable waste management and recycling by Green Avartan, and forest creation initiatives by Dharti Amit enter the tank. With ecopreneurship at the forefront, will the Sharks invest in these brands?

videos.title: Young Founders And Big Ideas
videos.overview: Private event platform for networking by Two Words Away, a student opportunity platform by PeerX, handmade crochet by Floreal, and a smart pet collar and GPS tracker by MyPerro. Will the Sharks invest in brands built by these young entrepreneurs?
